objective: Fix Ctrl+T being swallowed by QScintilla inside SQL editors and remove the Ctrl+/ keyPressEvent workaround.
tests_added: SqlEditor releases the Scintilla bindings for Ctrl+T and Ctrl+/
MainWindow: Ctrl+T with editor focus opens a tab and leaves the document text untouched, and Ctrl+/ still toggles comments
design_decisions: Root cause measured, not assumed: QsciScintillaBase accepts the ShortcutOverride event for every key in its own command set, so the editor received a plain KeyPress and the new_tab QAction never got a Shortcut event. With focus outside the editor the override was declined and the action fired, which is why the shortcut appeared to work only in some places.
Unbind the conflicting keys from the per-instance QsciCommandSet in SqlEditor._setup_editor rather than intercepting keys in keyPressEvent, so Qt's normal shortcut dispatch owns the sequences.
Ctrl+A/C/V/X/Y/Z also collide with Scintilla commands but carry equivalent semantics, so they were deliberately left bound.
SqlEditor._toggle_comment_action had a WidgetShortcut shortcut but was never added to the widget, so it could not fire once the keyPressEvent hack was removed; it is now registered with addAction.

MainWindow.toggle_comment_action kept its Ctrl+/ sequence for the menu label but moved to WidgetShortcut context, because two active Ctrl+/ shortcuts registered as an ambiguous overload and neither fired.
results: 630 tests pass; ruff check, ruff format, and ty check are clean.
